title: GreetTitle
description: A lightweight Minecraft 1.20 and 1.20.1 datapack that shows a customizable join title to each player when they enter a world or server, with per-player saved settings.
body:
# GreetTitle Datapack

GreetTitle is a simple and lightweight Minecraft Java 1.20 and 1.20.1 datapack that displays a clean on-screen title when a player joins your world or multiplayer server.

When a player joins, only that player sees their own title, such as:

**WELCOME, PlayerName**

Each player can also choose their own saved GreetTitle style using easy in-game `/trigger` commands. One player changing their title will not affect anyone else.

## Features

- Shows a join title when a player enters
- Only the joining player sees the title
- Supports multiplayer servers
- Per-player saved settings
- Players can choose their own title style
- Uses simple `/trigger` commands
- No mods required
- Lightweight and easy to install
- Made for Minecraft Java Edition 1.20 and 1.20.1

## Player Commands

Players can use these commands in chat:

`/trigger wm_set set 1`  
Set your title to the default style.

`/trigger wm_set set 2`  
Set your title to the HELLO style.

`/trigger wm_set set 3`  
Set your title to the server style.

`/trigger wm_set set 8`  
Preview your own saved title.

`/trigger wm_set set 9`  
Show the help menu.

## Installation

1. Download the datapack.
2. Put it inside your world or server `datapacks` folder.
3. Run `/reload` or restart the world/server.
4. Join the world/server and enjoy GreetTitle.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft Java Edition 1.20 and 1.20.1
- Works in singleplayer and multiplayer
- Does not require Fabric, Forge, Quilt, or any other mod loader
